reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 26 original noun exercises. Checked each complete German sentence and each of four offered options, gender/case/number where relevant, unique answer within the offered set, bilingual hints and explanations, distinct contexts and source/provenance. Seven source records deferred for regional usage, source errors, rights or ambiguity; no filler. Reviewed existing production, initial, B2, workplace and general-expansion objective inventories; no exact objective reuse found. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
